program='''def transform(grid):
    border = grid[0][0]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rows3 = [r for r in range(h) if any(v == 3 for v in grid[r])]
    cols3 = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] == 3 for r in range(h))]
    vertical = max(sum(grid[r][c] == 3 for r in range(h)) for c in range(w)) > max(sum(v == 3 for v in row) for row in grid)
    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 2:
                out[r][c] = 2
            elif (vertical and c in cols3) or (not vertical and r in rows3):
                out[r][c] = 3
            elif (vertical and 2 in grid[r]) or (not vertical and 2 in [grid[rr][c] for rr in range(h)]):
                out[r][c] = border
    return out
'''
